payload.answer: Locally (already done once, repeatable): next build && next start, then curl with spoofed Host headers — chat-host / → 200 chat page; chat-host [path] → 308 chat root; chat-host [path] and [path]<slug> → 308 hire host with query; chat-host [path], [path], [path], [path], [path], [path], [path] → 200; hire-host [path] → 308 chat root; hire-host / and [path] → 200; localhost [path] → 200. In production the same curl checklist runs after the manual Netlify domain alias + Porkbun CNAME are added; Playwright stays localhost-only and is not a gate.
